RVA-F-0242.question: Do the bounded advisor movie and accept/cancel name anchors identify a cosmetic suppression gate, or only construction and presentation forwarding?

scope.boundary: Four exact functions and three exact naming anchors. No advisor show producer, completion callback, gameplay-decision discriminator, enqueue ownership, or universal popup control is established.

dependencies.use: Accepted identity and bounded entry-lookup role of scene tree walker 0x82D51160; the topic name does not establish audio semantics for the advisor callers.

currentEvidence.method: Capped string and split-address queries; exact-entry decompilation; bounded native words and narrow exact-function generated corroboration.

constructor.result: The local instructions pass the movie-name address 0x82124050 in r4 with r5/r6 equal to one. Exact-entry decompilation and generated code show subsequent receiver initialization. This is a construction boundary, not an accepted show/hide gate.

currentEvidence.forwardingResult: Both local name-materialization calls target 0x821B2AD8. Both guarded forwarding tails call 0x82E42DA0. The intermediate lookup path remains incomplete in the decompiler because 0x821B15C0 is modeled as nonreturning; generated corroboration alone does not establish complete native lookup-path coverage.

bridge.result: Native word 0x4BF0E355 at 0x82E42E0C independently binds the call to the accepted scene tree walker; exact-entry decompilation and generated corroboration place it under the receiver byte +0x4 and singleton low-bit guards. No gameplay accept/cancel callback identity is established.

currentEvidence.qualification: Static local edge evidence only. Function-model absence at the three interior addresses is not evidence of missing code. Native radius windows include adjacent-function words that are excluded from semantic claims. The independently recovered local edges do not close caller reachability or the full named-ID lookup chain.
currentEvidence.imageCheck: All 166 returned native word rows match the hash-bound supported image.

staticQuery.bounds: The initial string query returned 40 matches under a 96-match cap. The three-address split query returned three candidates under its 32-total cap, without truncation. Four exact advisor bodies were interpreted, each within 120 decompiler lines and a combined 96 KiB cap. Five radius-16 native windows supplied 165 rows; one final radius-zero word pins the bridge call.

guards: Do not infer a safe advisor-off setting or disable the shared scene tree walker.
Do not equate accept/cancel presentation names with gameplay choice handling, acknowledgement, or queue completion.
Do not infer audio behavior from the legacy dependency topic name.
RVA-F-0242.conclusion: The bounded anchors identify a constructor and two named presentation-forwarding wrappers. They do not identify an optional-advice discriminator or a lifecycle-safe suppression gate. Further work requires an exact advisor show/enqueue consumer and its decision/acknowledgement completion contract; runtime suppression remains unaccepted.

RVA-F-0248.question: Which direct call sites reach advisor show 0x82CE8338, which cue index and force flags does each pass, and what native gate can return -1 before any presentation?

scope.boundary: Every aligned raw direct branch-and-link to 0x82CE8338 in initialized executable memory, the 16 native words on each side of each site, the entry gate 0x82CE8338..0x82CE838C and the cue switch 0x82CE852C..0x82CE8564. Indirect or computed calls, per-site text, trigger conditions and result consumers beyond the first instruction are outside this bound.

dependencies.use: Accepted movie constructor and presentation-forwarding boundary below the show path.
Accepted receiver 0x8314F76C slot +0x30 target 0x82D84630 and its -1 return chain.

currentEvidence.method: One capped raw direct-caller query, radius-16 native word windows at every site, exact native windows for the entry gate and cue switch, a straight-line argument-register decode, and narrow generated-code corroboration for three branch-merged sites and for containing-function starts.

entryGate.result: Advisor show returns through 0x82CE87F8 without presentation when byte 0x8314EF9F is nonzero, the low byte of r6 is zero, byte 0x8314F10B is nonzero and the low byte of r7 is zero. A nonzero r6 or r7 low byte bypasses this gate. The separate nesting word 0x8314F1B8 and word 0x82FFE7C4 bit 0x40000000 checks at 0x82CE8394..0x82CE83A8 lead to the cleanup early-out 0x82CE87A8.

cueSwitch.result: When receiver 0x8314F76C slot +0x34 returns a zero low byte, the low byte of r3 indexes a six-entry table. Indexes 0, 1, 2 and 3 select the blocks at 0x82CE85F8, 0x82CE8598, 0x82CE85C8 and 0x82CE8568, which pass name addresses 0x8214FAF8, 0x8214FAD0, 0x8214FAE4 and 0x8214FAC0 through 0x82E6A430 to receiver slot +0x38. Index 4 selects no name. Index 5 passes 0x8214FB08 and, when bit 0x800 of word 0x830E4550 is clear, also 0x8214FB14. Values above five select no name.

argumentDecode.forceFlags: 168 sites set r6 and r7 to zero on the straight-line path before the call. Site 0x82DF9958 sets r7 to one and loads r6 from stack +0x60.
argumentDecode.highByte: Constant r3 values also carry 0x100, 0x200 or 0x400. The show path passes r3 unchanged to receiver slot +0x30; this inventory assigns no meaning to those bits.

currentEvidence.knownProducers: 0x82CECCD8 is the technology choice prompt and 0x82D1D1C0 the turn-start check that calls it; 0x82D06398 holds the two Special Functions menu calls recorded by special-functions-options-dispatch.
currentEvidence.qualification: The decode reads the nearest straight-line writer within 16 words and stops at branches; other incoming paths can set different values. Containing functions come from generated-code function starts because the canonical project defines no function at these sites; they group sites and do not prove reachability. The first instruction after each call does not classify a result as a required choice or as ignored.
currentEvidence.imageCheck: All 5683 returned native word rows match the hash-bound supported image, and all 169 caller words decode as relative branch-and-link instructions to 0x82CE8338.

staticQuery.bounds: The caller query returned 169 matches under a 256-match cap without truncation. No caller function body was expanded.

guards: Do not treat the cue index as a per-popup identity; many distinct producers share one index.
Do not infer the meaning of bytes 0x8314EF9F or 0x8314F10B from this gate; their producers and semantics remain separately bounded.
Do not classify any site as optional, informational or safe to suppress from this inventory alone.
Do not assume a -1 return is tolerated by a producer outside the gate mode in which the native early-out occurs.
RVA-F-0248.conclusion: Advisor show has 169 direct call sites in 52 generated-code producer functions. Each passes a cue index in the low byte of r3 that selects one of four named advisor cues, no cue, or the index-5 cue pair. 168 sites pass zero force flags, so the native entry gate returns -1 for all of them when both gate bytes are nonzero; only 0x82DF9958 can force presentation. A per-popup control needs each producer's trigger, text identity and result consumer; the cue index alone supports at most a per-cue grouping.

RVA-F-0249.question: For 65 direct callers of advisor show 0x82CE8338, does any path read the returned r3, and where a site branches on it, which branch does a -1 return take?

scope.boundary: Every path from each site's return address through its .pdata function, every callee entered while r3 still holds the result, and, where the result reaches a function return, every aligned direct branch-and-link to that function, repeated for up to six caller levels. The other 104 inventory sites, trigger conditions and per-site text are outside this bound.

dependencies.use: Accepted direct-caller inventory, the -1 entry gate and the cleanup early-out 0x82CE87A8 reached from the nesting checks.

currentEvidence.method: A local PowerPC decode of the hash-checked flat image follows r3 from each return address. Any instruction that names r3 as a source, including compares, stores, copies, memory bases and arguments to a callee that reads it, ends the path as a use. An instruction that writes r3 without reading it ends the path as overwritten. Conditional branches follow both arms, direct calls are entered, save-thunk calls are register-neutral and branches into the restore thunks are returns. Function bounds come from .pdata.

readSites.result: Only r3 == 0 reaches the call 0x82D00550 at 0x82D1D3AC; -1 branches past it with every other nonzero answer.
Only r3 == 0 runs the block at 0x82D083EC; -1 branches to 0x82D0844C with every other nonzero answer.

Only r3 == 1 runs the block at 0x82CEB2A4; -1 branches with every other answer to the epilogue of 0x82CEA5A0. Its only direct caller 0x82D0A890 overwrites r3 on every path, and no stored pointer to 0x82CEA5A0 exists outside .pdata.

currentEvidence.unreadSites: On the other 62 sites every explored path overwrites r3 before any read. No undecoded word or indirect branch was reached while r3 held the result. Site 0x82D1775C reaches the self-recursive 0x82D13978 and needs five caller levels. No function through which the result returns has a stored pointer outside .pdata.

staticQuery.nativeSupport: Radius-4 word windows at the 65 return addresses and at 0x82CEB340, 0x82D0A894 and 0x82D0844C. All 612 words matched the flat image identified by image.json, which supplied every word the local decode walked.
staticQuery.bounds: No match cap applies; the direct-caller scan covers every aligned word in .text.

guards: A use means any read of r3; an overwritten path proves only that the advisor show result is not read on that path.
Do not treat -1 as an answer the dialog can return; it is the native early-out value, which the three read sites handle like any answer other than their compared value.
Indirect calls are excluded only by the absence of stored function pointers; a computed function address would fall outside this bound.
The walk is bound to this image; another build needs a new walk.
RVA-F-0249.conclusion: Of 65 advisor show sites, 62 never read the returned r3: every path overwrites it within the producer or within one, two or five caller levels. The other three compare it once against a single value, so a -1 return takes the same branch as every other non-matching answer: 0x82D1D3A0 and 0x82D083E0 compare with 0, and 0x82CEB298 compares with 1 and otherwise returns to a caller that discards the value.
